visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-energy stage performance inside a bustling shopping mall atrium. Two main performers, a man in a pink and white jumpsuit and a woman in a yellow and white dress with a small orange mascot bag, are seen dancing with wide, synchronized arm movements and enthusiastic smiles. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a modern retail environment, and a large crowd is visible in the background, including several children and parents watching the show. (2) The scene cuts to a backstage preparation area under a white tent. The female performer in yellow is shown from a medium close-up angle, smiling warmly at the camera while someone adjusts her costume or hair. She has small decorative heart stickers on her cheeks and is wearing a microphone headset. The background is simple and functional, focusing entirely on her cheerful and excited facial expression during this private moment. (3) Back on the stage, the performance continues with a third female performer in a pink dress joining the group. They are waving their arms in unison to the audience. The camera then pans to a young girl in a pink shirt and a fox-ear headband being held by an older man with glasses. The girl stares blankly at the stage, appearing confused or unimpressed by the spectacle, creating a stark contrast to the performers' energy. (4) The video transitions to a final pose where the female performer in yellow is now holding the young girl on the stage. They are flanked by the other performers and a large, costumed mascot of a fox. Everyone is smiling and waving at the camera for a commemorative photo. The child now looks slightly more at ease but still somewhat bewildered by being the center of attention in such a loud and colorful setting.
